topic_theme: Western Union to Launch Solana-Based Stablecoin
primary_headline: Western Union to Launch Solana-Based Stablecoin Plus ‘Stable Card’ Next Month
combined_key_facts: Western Union is launching a Solana-based stablecoin called USDPT.
The stablecoin is expected to launch next month.
A 'Stable Card' will be launched alongside the stablecoin.
The USDPT stablecoin will be used for agent settlements as an alternative to SWIFT, not for consumer transactions.
Western Union's CEO, Devin McGranahan, stated the focus is on expanding digital asset adoption within their core platform.
